title: Laptop setup for new joiners
body: New joiners receive their laptop on the first day. IT installs the VPN client, the password manager and the chat app before handing it over.

title: Access to the knowledge base
body: Every new joiner gets read access to the team spaces of their department. Write access is requested by the team lead.

title: Password reset takes too long
body: Users report that the password reset email arrives after more than ten minutes. The mail relay queue is suspected.
